variants.name: Soft Slate
variants.prompt: Edit the attached Kuizer eraser app icon to create a distinct variant named SOFT SLATE. Preserve its recognizable idea: a diagonal eraser pointing from lower-left to upper-right, centered inside a purple rounded-square app tile, with the original general composition, proportions and generous transparent outside margin. Follow the user's request to make it less realistic. Style: premium stylized 2.5D app icon, soft inflated rounded shapes, beautifully controlled lavender-to-violet gradients, broad smooth highlights and gentle depth. Remove ALL photographic microtexture, grain, realistic chrome, lens reflections, engraved rings, glitter, and crystal fragments. Replace the original silver ridged band with one simple smooth darker-lavender collar without metal reflections. Eraser has a matte pearl-white lower half and a pastel lavender upper half, both smooth and slightly puffy. Tile is a soft periwinkle-to-deep-violet gradient with a single clean lighter inset rim and very restrained thickness. Use just two tiny simple rounded violet crumbs near the eraser tip, no realistic chips. Very clean edges, strong small-size silhouette, calm and friendly rather than shiny luxury product photography. Keep some soft dimensionality and overlapping shadows so it is polished, not a flat pictogram. No realistic physical materials, no extra objects or text, no watermark. Genuine alpha transparency outside the tile, preserve existing transparency. One icon only on a square 1024x1024 canvas.

variants.name: Graphic Slate
variants.prompt: Edit this exact attached Kuizer purple eraser app icon into a second alternative named GRAPHIC SLATE. Keep the core identity: a single diagonal eraser from lower-left to upper-right on a violet rounded-square app tile, original overall composition, premium app-icon finish, genuine transparent outside background and generous margin. This variant should be noticeably more graphic and less realistic than the source. Art direction: beautifully drawn vector-like 2.5D illustration with bold simple geometry, large uninterrupted color surfaces, smooth selective gradients, crisp rounded edges and only subtle shallow depth. Reshape the eraser as a clean rounded rectangular block with a slightly angled lower working edge. Upper half is saturated iris purple, lower half is warm ivory. Join the two halves with a precise diagonal division; REMOVE the metallic collar entirely. Use one narrow simple lilac highlight along the upper edge, and a single soft graphic cast shadow beneath the eraser. Purple tile is a deep plum-to-indigo gradient, with one fine violet inset keyline, no thick glass rim or realistic bevel. Replace the crystal debris with three tiny simple rounded squares in lavender arranged sparsely below the eraser tip. No realistic textures, grain, brushed metal, reflections, glass refraction, crystals, dust, glitter, lens flares, or photorealistic lighting. It should feel designed as a brand mark and app icon rather than rendered as a physical product. Preserve tactile charm through soft shapes, NOT surface realism. No letters, labels or watermark. One finished icon only, square 1024x1024, alpha transparency around the tile.
